description: ArchGuard-APR is a research prototype for architecture-constraint-aware automated program repair using deterministic repository graphs, explicit architecture profiles, graph-guided context retrieval, isolated execution feedback, and reproducible source-free artifacts. Its Phase 13 evaluation is exploratory and underpowered and provides no effectiveness or superiority claim.
